propositions: Cancelled runs on the main branch render as red X on GitHub despite main being healthy, because concurrency.cancel-in-progress=true cancels superseded runs
Main-branch CI must switch from push-triggered to schedule-triggered (every 6 hours at staggered off-hour minutes: 41, 47, 53) to avoid cancellations by construction
Workflows test.yml, optionality.yml, verify-identity.yml, prompt-eval.yml must add main to push.branches-ignore; codeql.yml and terraform-drift.yml must drop their push trigger entirely
A new main-health-report job must publish the last-known-green SHA from GitHub Actions API and emit a copy-pasteable git bisect run command to GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY on failure
All touched workflows must retain workflow_dispatch for on-demand health checks; external-integration.yml, gerrit-verify.yaml, and reconciler workflows must not be modified

Unit tests must verify trigger policy (no main push match, non-main push preserved, cadences correct) and report rendering (green path names SHA, red path emits bisect recipe, lookup failures degrade gracefully)
